summary: Fixed signed window-state indexing that produced NaNs and black daylight quads, and explicitly disabled daytime emission. Both LODs now keep per-floor/per-bay baked window state with dark mullions, calmer reflections and unclipped night lighting. Preserved roof/industrial detail and lotSurface, added residential frontage access gaps, corrected exact perimeter seating and terrain-change reseating, kept growth origins fixed through serialization, and made draw/lit/crop/relief diagnostics reflect generated and rendered data. Final 28-shot and API verification complete; two measured acceptance failures remain and visual quality is below the 8.5 bar.

Whole-scene triangle peaks remain 2,274,876 and aerial 1,671,264 on reflection frames despite 84 m LOD switch. The richer pane-level LOD and retained roof equipment need more geometry optimization; scene heap peak is 631.3 MB.

Facade materials, large stepped crowns and flat shop interior cards still fall below the reference realism. Some parking texture flecks and regular lawn bands remain visible; this is not claimed fully resolved.
The night_downtown camera was repositioned to expose the actual tallest selected tower; its elevated framing provides less street-level retail context. block_22 supplies the retail corroboration.
The integrated all showcase is an empty new-game map: it verifies ready/error behavior with all modules but does not stage the 347-building showcase.
